Which replay semantics should implementation planning assume?

Which replay semantics shall constitute the normative specification basis for subsequent planning, if planning is separately authorized?




とします。

Option	Semantics	Consequence

A	One-Time Consumption	first successful use consumes authorization

B	Scoped Consumption	authorization may be reused within defined scope/time
